scope: R125 measured cost attribution for one warm DiT evaluation on the original 910A. Hooks synchronize per module, so absolute seconds are inflated (~2.6x) versus the uninstrumented step and must be read as relative shares only.
interpretation: Attention dominates the step by roughly an order of magnitude over the MLP, so residency, tensor caching and elementwise fusion cannot reach the 15 s/step goal; only an efficient fused attention kernel can.
caveat: Per-module synchronize distorts attribution: the first measured module absorbs pipeline drain, and totals exceed the real step time.
